scenarios.title: Fresh direct evidence resolves one criterion
scenarios.oracle: PASS is allowed only when the artifact, criterion and evidence digests match and the procedure is observed fresh.
scenarios.rationale: This is the smallest complete Claim to Procedure to Evidence to Status lineage.

scenarios.title: Structural profile resolves a bounded criterion set
scenarios.oracle: PASS is valid for both required criteria when every observation is within the declared profile bounds.
scenarios.rationale: A multi-criterion run must preserve one lineage record per required criterion.

scenarios.title: Security-aware profile confirms denied boundaries
scenarios.oracle: PASS is valid when all external boundary fields are explicitly denied and loop counters are bounded.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier can confirm policy metadata without executing any external boundary.

scenarios.title: Observed procedure finds a required criterion failure
scenarios.oracle: FAIL is returned when a fresh procedure observation contradicts the criterion while identity and freshness remain valid.
scenarios.rationale: A factual verifier must preserve a negative observation instead of converting it to a block or pass.

scenarios.title: Required schema check returns a known failure
scenarios.oracle: FAIL is returned when the observed schema is readable and current but does not satisfy the frozen criterion.
scenarios.rationale: Known bad artifact content is different from missing or stale evidence.

scenarios.title: Report contains an explicit failing role observation
scenarios.oracle: FAIL is returned only for an observed role condition that is current and attributable to the criterion.
scenarios.rationale: The report records the fact while leaving assurance and approval decisions to their owners.

scenarios.title: Optional evidence is unavailable while required evidence is fresh
scenarios.oracle: PARTIAL is returned when the required criterion is observed but an explicitly optional evidence item is unavailable.
scenarios.rationale: Optional coverage must not be presented as complete coverage or block the required factual result.

scenarios.title: Host observation is conditional but local evidence is complete
scenarios.oracle: PARTIAL is returned when local deterministic evidence passes but host causality is explicitly unobserved.
scenarios.rationale: A native fixture cannot impersonate a host-loaded external capability.

scenarios.title: One non-required procedure exceeds available context
scenarios.oracle: PARTIAL is returned when required observations are complete and a non-required procedure is omitted at a context bound.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier must preserve the omission and its limitation without widening the budget.

scenarios.title: Required artifact is absent
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a required artifact cannot be identified or observed.
scenarios.rationale: No criterion can receive a PASS from an absent subject.

scenarios.title: Required criteria are not frozen
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when no stable required criterion set is bound to the input.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier cannot choose or mutate acceptance criteria on behalf of another role.

scenarios.title: Requested procedure is outside the declared policy
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when the requested procedure requires a denied boundary or undeclared tool.
scenarios.rationale: A missing execution capability is reported, never simulated or silently substituted.

scenarios.title: Artifact digest changed after evidence capture
scenarios.oracle: STALE is returned when the evidence identity is bound to an older artifact digest.
scenarios.rationale: Historical evidence remains recorded but cannot support a current PASS.

scenarios.title: Freshness receipt is older than the declared window
scenarios.oracle: STALE is returned when required evidence has no current freshness receipt.
scenarios.rationale: Freshness is a prerequisite for status, not an advisory annotation.

scenarios.title: Required criterion has no evidence reference
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a required criterion has no evidence reference or unavailable observation.
scenarios.rationale: A status without evidence lineage is not a verifiable result.

scenarios.title: Evidence reference exists but its observation is unavailable
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a required evidence reference is explicitly unavailable.
scenarios.rationale: Unavailable evidence is an honest stop, not a pass-through placeholder.

scenarios.title: Required declared observer is unavailable
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a required tool is absent and no safe deterministic observation exists.
scenarios.rationale: Tool absence must not be hidden by claiming that a procedure ran.

scenarios.title: Optional observer is absent without affecting required facts
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is returned for a requested tool-specific required observation even when related local data is available.
scenarios.rationale: The requested procedure cannot be silently downgraded from required to optional.

scenarios.title: Report points to a different artifact digest
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when report artifact identity differs from the authorized artifact identity.
scenarios.rationale: A matching filename or criterion is insufficient without exact identity binding.

scenarios.title: Evidence parent identity does not match the report
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when an evidence parent identity is not the authorized artifact.
scenarios.rationale: Parent binding prevents evidence from being transplanted between artifacts.

scenarios.title: Criterion digest changes during verification
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when the criteria digest changes after the run is bound.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier cannot redefine the acceptance target to make a result pass.

scenarios.title: Required criterion is removed from a final report
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a final report omits a frozen required criterion.
scenarios.rationale: Coverage cannot be raised by shrinking the required set inside the verifier.

scenarios.title: Builder asks the verifier to approve its own artifact
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a builder requests approval rather than a factual verification report.
scenarios.rationale: Verification can report facts but cannot approve the producing role's work.

scenarios.title: Builder role is embedded as the verifier actor
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when actor identity combines BUILDER and VERIFIER authority.
scenarios.rationale: Role separation is enforced by identity, not by a prose promise in the report.

scenarios.title: Verifier attempts to change the inspected artifact
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when the verifier requests workspace mutation or repair.
scenarios.rationale: The package is read-only and cannot make its own evidence current by changing the subject.

scenarios.title: Verifier tries to rewrite a criterion or evidence record
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when verifier output would mutate criteria or evidence lineage.
scenarios.rationale: Reports are immutable observations; a separate owner must produce any new input.

scenarios.title: Artifact text contains an instruction-like override
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when untrusted artifact text attempts to change verifier policy or authority.
scenarios.rationale: Artifact content is data and cannot issue instructions to the verifier.

scenarios.title: Evidence note requests a hidden authority escalation
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when evidence text asks the verifier to ignore role, freshness or identity gates.
scenarios.rationale: Evidence is inspected input and has no authority to alter the verification contract.

scenarios.title: Reference selection exceeds the bounded byte budget
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when selected reference bytes exceed the declared context budget.
scenarios.rationale: Context limits are a safety boundary and cannot be bypassed by loading more material.

scenarios.title: Procedure count exceeds the per-run bound
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when the requested procedure count exceeds the declared per-run limit.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier stops at a deterministic bound instead of expanding scope indefinitely.

scenarios.title: Artifact reference contains a parent-segment escape
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when an artifact reference resolves outside the authorized project boundary.
scenarios.rationale: Path confinement is checked before any metadata read.

scenarios.title: Reference alias resolves outside the package
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a reference alias or symlink does not remain inside the approved package.
scenarios.rationale: The loader must reject aliases and traversal without following them.

scenarios.title: Generic improvement request has no verification target
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when activation has no identified artifact, criterion set or factual verification outcome.
scenarios.rationale: The verifier does not activate for every request or expand an unspecified task.

scenarios.title: Visual quality judgment is routed to the verifier
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when the requested outcome is visual judgment rather than factual artifact verification.
scenarios.rationale: The VISUAL profile checks identity and structure only; visual quality belongs to an independent critic.

scenarios.title: Explicit artifact verification request activates the verifier
scenarios.oracle: PASS is allowed when the request explicitly supplies a verifiable artifact, frozen criterion and fresh evidence.
scenarios.rationale: The activation boundary must admit the capability's intended factual use.

scenarios.title: Freshness-only check activates for a known artifact
scenarios.oracle: PASS is allowed when the request is limited to deterministic freshness validation with all identities bound.
scenarios.rationale: A narrow verification request should not be rejected merely because it has one criterion.

scenarios.title: No progress remains after the bounded observation
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a bounded observation produces no new evidence or status progress.
scenarios.rationale: No-progress detection prevents repeated work from becoming an unbounded loop.

scenarios.title: The same procedure fails at its single allowed attempt
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory after the declared one-attempt procedure failure without an implicit retry loop.
scenarios.rationale: Repeated failure is a typed stop condition and not a reason to expand execution authority.

scenarios.title: Hardlink alias is rejected as an outside-workspace artifact
scenarios.oracle: BLOCKED is mandatory when a regular-file descriptor has more than one link and cannot prove a unique confined artifact.
scenarios.rationale: Hardlink aliases must not turn a confined path into an outside-workspace read or replayable artifact.

scenarios.title: Fresh evidence cannot override an old declared evidence reference
scenarios.oracle: STALE is mandatory when the declared EvidenceRef observation predates the verification input, even if the procedure receipt is marked fresh.
scenarios.rationale: Freshness is a property of the complete Claim to Procedure to Evidence reference chain, not only the materialized evidence object.
